title: BWSSB fails residents after collecting Kaver connectioni charges
description:
The residents and businesses, providing many jobs, are facing severe hardship due to no Kaveri water connection. Residents have been paying property taxes since 2006, yet we have not received any roads, or water connection. All Borewells in the layout, have gone dry and water tankers are charging exorbitant amounts to supply water. Last year the BWSSB issued notices and threatened, all residents and apartments, with blocking of sewage lines, if they did not apply and pay the charges to BWSSB for Kaveri water connection. Almost 60% owners and apartments have paid the demand charges of BWSSB. Others are waiting for BWSSB to put the Main Kaveri water line, into the layout, as they don't trust thr BWSSB, to keep their commitment. BWSSB, started the work and immediately stopped the laying of the main water line. When contacted, they are blaming the BBMP for not giving road cutting permission. This is all rubbish excuses. Even our local people representatives, are showing no concern for the hardship faced by the citizens. The situation, due to summer is now alarming. I urge our local leaders to kindly look into the matter and clear unnecessary bottlenecks, cause by people with vested interests. 

General Secretary SSLOA

Sir/Madam, 

This is umamaheswaran,  a father two daughters,  i stay at bommanhalli and i work in a comany at bellandur & i commute to work via silk board, hsr layout to reach bellandur circle.

My wife & two of my young daughters (6years old & 6 months baby) are completely depend on me,  we are trying to come out of this slowly.  Here our humble request is to look into this pothole of service road & kindly get it fixed before others meet such accidents in that place. 

Looking forward for your support to avoid further such accidents. 

Thanks. 

Regards, 
Umamaheswaran

title: Harassment Done by Garbage Collectors
description: Hi. I am resident of Doddabele kengeri. Bbmp garbage collection van will not come to our place as it is under Panchayat and also from Panchayat side also no measures are taken. Till date I was burning the garbage infront of my house as there was no other option. From few days as rain was there, there was wet surface it was not fully burning. So what I thought was putting garbage to the van. Everyday I used to see the van around 8:45 to 9:15 AM near brindavan layout which is near ksrtc or bmtc workshop which comes under bbmp limit. On 10th I carried garbage in a bio degradable plastic bag and as usual I saw the van and I was going to office.If van was not there I thought of putting near my home only where we used to burn or where the villagers will dump the garbage. As I saw van there only I turned my vehicle to put the garbage as I was in speed and went little bit ahead. Those  people harassed me like anything in the road. I don't know some was throwing the garbage on the road everyday. They thought I am only putting everyday and they argued. They made me touch his feet and When argument continued one fellow from his mobile he was showing some fine put for some other fellow and asked me to pay him some amount. I refused then he took my photo with the vehicle where garbage cover was there on the foot rust of my Access 125 vehicle and told I will this as proof . And he also told I will put all the garbage near our home and go. I told him I came to put in the van not on road. He told how I can see auto from Doddabele..  I told daily I am going in this road and daily I was seeing the vehicle.One fellow somewhere he came and started , I turned vehicle after seeing him and he was setting where someone was putting garbage daily. Other fellow who was showing the fines in mobile( I think the head for these people)  confiscated my vehicle key which police also will not do and asked me to come to office and pay the penalty and he called some one and told he called health inspector and gave to me. I told him I am not putting and told him I I came to put in the van. But he was supporting him only... That fellow told lie to him that same color cover will be there everyday.. He tried to break my vehicle lock and confiscated vehicle key also.After that he made to me pay 500 RS but paid 480 as I was having only that much.He behaved with me very badly. What is the proof that I am only putting the garbage?? Don't other people have same color cover??. They looted me and took 480 rs which was there in my wallet. Also the inspector also talking to me in a rude way... This is very bad. Before this one day I took the cover and went to put in the auto..  Auto was not there and the woman who collect the garbage thrown on the road side was there. I went to her and asked to take she told she will not take asked to put in the auto. I waited for few.minutes and auto did not came. So I put the same in the village where all the villagers are putting. I also don't want to put there as I also know it is dangerous... This time auto was there only .So I went to put there. They did this because will pay if they ask give some money as they will take the garbage from all the houses. But if these people starts looting how anyone will feel to follow the rules???. This matter I discussed with BBMP commissioner Mr. Anil Kumar via messenger.. He assigned the complaint to Naveen Kumar (JHI) : 8217783841. But did not notice any action against this harrasment.... Really I did not go to put the garbage on the road. I went to put the same to the van.... Still Somany people are putting garbage there only. I will attach the photo . This photo was taken on Last Friday on 13th of September while coming back from the office.

title: Road is blocked since 3 weeks
description:
It's been 3 weeks this road is blocked. Many people who travel via this road taking u turn and traveling 3 km extra to reach doddanekundi ORR. Under railway bridge it always gets blocked with rain water whenever little heavy rain comes. Other way is so horrible to cross track.
In the attached pic you can see people crossing the road by walking above railway track. Daily thousands of people travel this way. They use this way as an alternative way whenever water is clogged under bridge. From yesterday onwards this way also blocked by some local guys with a stone fence.
 I have sent all ages people like many young men and women employees, mainly elderly people and kids, Mothers carrying kids, daily workers etc. crossing this worst way daily. But today I have seen all these people climbing and jumping on the stone fence. It's very sad to see women, old people and kids taking such risks daily. And the way is too slippery once someone slips then they directly fall into the flood water under the bridge. Please take this complaint seriously and help us people who stays in Doddanekundi. Thanks.

title: Installation of LED Street Lights and replacing them with Old Sodium Vapour lighting
description:
Sir, 
I have been observing for last 3 years that many of the old sodium vapour street lights on the Kodigehalli Main Road, KR Puram (Ward No 53 and 54) are not functioning or they are very old and does not give proper lights at night time. When most of the smart cities and big cities have moved to LED street lights, I don't see the same being installed on many roads in Bangalore's nook and corners. It saves energy and electricity cost and brighter than what a sodium vapour lamp provides at night.

I would request BBMP to take necessary action to replace all the old functional and non-functional Sodium Vapour lamps from the kodigehalli main road with the bright LED lights instead. I have seen other side of the Devasandra has already lighted up with Bright LED lights at night and gives a good view to the commuters at night and saves electricity for Govt.

Sir,
We regret to bring to your kind notice that the Garbage container of our locality is overflowing due to non-cleaning for many days. Worst of all, the garbage is now is now emitting a foul smell and is giving our neighborhood a bad image.
Therefore, It's our humbly request that the same may kindly be cleaned by today itself so that we can have a normal life soon.
Thanking you,
Yours faithfully,
Resident of VS Reddy Colony, 2nd Cross, 
Patalamma Layout, Kadugodi, Whitefield

description: People who resides in rented makeshift homes at Kaggadasapura dont have access to regular water supply. They has to get drinking water from bbmp drinking water unit where instead of 5 Rs per 20 Lts of water they has to pay 10 Rs and need to show aadhar and submit phone number. And the bbmp water unit also needs to be run properly with accountable people taking care of it. Instead of 8 AM it gets opened at 9 AM or beyond that time in morning. This complaint has already made by another citizen Vasudevan of this area 2 years back but till now it is in same condition no improvements.

title: Cleanliness and Hiegine in Vijaya Field / Srinagar Play ground
description:
Hello Madam,

Hope you are doing well .

I am a citizen of Basavanagudi Constituency since 25 years and resident of 560050 Pincode areas since 10+  years. 
As of now, I am staying in 6th main road, Kalappa Block, Srinagar . This email is regarding the cleanliness and hygiene maintained in Vijaya Field / Srinagar Play Ground.

Many residents nearby visit the ground for morning walk  / jog including my parents. It includes small kids as well as Old aged people. People prefer ground instead of roads because of pollution and social distancing. 

Day by day the plastic covers, tea/coffee cups, water cans are increasing which inturn increase the spread of virus / bacterias which is highly risky at this point of time.

We don't see any cleaners who clean the nearby garbage dumping area as well. Next to it is a drinking water unit and which is very risky if the stagnant water gets infected. 

This is a request from all the residents nearby to help us allot a Point of Contact  for the cleanliness In and Around field .
Lets stop the spread of virus before it gets worse.

Note : We directly told  few people who were littering there. But, we can't tell everyone by staying there for the whole day. The problem gets solved if a cleaner is alloted especially to this place. 

Also, there are multiple places in the cross roads where people are dumping garbage and which is like inviting Corona to our locality.

I have added the pictures and videos for your reference. 
Kindly call me or revert to the same mail if you need any information .

Thanks and Regards,
Supreeth

title: Suggestion for Clean Bangalore
description:
There are many vacant sites in our Layout and also in entire BBMP limits. The owners of this sites are not at all taking care or visit these sites. Many sites are turned into dump yards and senseless people are throwing plastic waste/all type of garbage on these sites and garbage dumps are formed on many sites. Many a times I have picked up plastic waste and handed over to BBMP garbage vans. A lot of unwanted bushes and vegetation grown on these sites are not cleaned which gives scope for snakes and rodents to make their home. Some sites are being used for illegal activities at nights. Vacant Site owners are not bothered. Problem is only for those who have constructed homes in between and residing there.
I request you to forward my following suggestion to concerned higher authorities, which will resolve the vacant site menace and also create revenue for BBMP and make Bangalore clean.
Most of these sites are purchased for investment purpose and those owners are comfortably staying in nice homes in other parts of Bengaluru. If any person who is already possessing a home or having a site in his name or in the name of his spouse in BBMP limits, and if he has any vacant site in Bengaluru, then a time limit of say 1 or 2 years to be given for any construction activity on that vacant site. If it is not done, then as a penalty, BBMP or Govt can charge property tax at ten times the normal tax, and maintain such sites, neatly. Alternatively, by  amending the related laws, Govt can take over such sites by paying a compensation at the rate of purchase price plus indexation benefit. 
Land is a scarce commodity, and Govt can not allow anyone to hoard it. Land price is jacked up only due to hoarding. As many politicians are holding huge vacant land in BBMP limits,I am aware that my suggestion will not be looked into. But I believe that some sincere officials in BBMP apply their mind to above suggestion which is source of revenue to BBMP and make my Bengaluru neat and clean.

title: More than 100 potholes within 2 kms of road strech on Hennur Cross.
description:
Respected Sir/Madam
In February 2021, an innocent girl  Tasdeeq Bushra got killed due to potholes that were left after the road was dug by BWSSB. BBMP even seeing that the road is not taken care of, did not do anything.

Both BBMP and BWSSB played the blame game. Even the BBMP Chief Mr. Gaurav Gupta did not care to answer anything related to this matter.

Now its September 2021, the condition remains the same with no plan of improvement and intention of covering potholes.

We the Bangalore citizens pay the highest amount of tax, even after that we can't get basic road facilities.

At least for humanity's sake, I would request all these so-called Babus (BBMP Chief, Local Corporator, Local MLA,) to please fix the road.

There have been more than 10 deaths alone in the last 2-3 years. I would say these deaths could have been avoided if the administration just did its job. Innocent lives are being lost due to potholes and ill-managed roads. This is not what as tax-paying citizens we expect in the year 2021.

BBMP Chief: Mr Gaurav Gupta
Local Corporator: Mr P Anand
Local MLA: Mr KJ George
MP: PC Mohan

Please at least give us roads to breathe, if not anything else!
Also, I have raised the same complaint in CPGRAMS, i.e. the PM grievance portal. Grievance Status number: MORTH/E/2021/09583
